browser distribution
https://registry.npmjs.org/@highlightjs/cdn-assets/-/cdn-assets-11.12.0.tgz
(registry integrity
sha512-KvOKXODaiFmId9xaq3xc5xCL66wVLUuOngDbO9B/kewbFTqdGbn2nJxNhN3H5R1cgDTVj6R8vH0zgiNDEGjpDw==,
tarball SHA-256 b8a006d30f45afe783072569f3d69c5b60c0e7b9ca28cd474e12f2584e2a3bd9).
highlight.min.js is the package's highlight.min.js, verbatim (it defines the global `hljs`).
Its banner reads `Highlight.js v11.12.0 (git: f7f7d3803b)` and it reports
`versionString="11.12.0"`.

This record was written after the fact (redtear1115/mars-dawn-kit#90): the file has not
changed since the kit's first commit, and it is byte-identical to that package's
highlight.min.js. The licence below is the package's LICENSE, also byte-identical.
Replacing highlight.min.js means redoing this record; VendoredHighlightJSTests fails until
the record matches the file.

SHA-256 of each vendored file, relative to this folder:
